name: Safeguard Paladin: [Class Bonus] prevent 2 non-combat damage to itself
notes: Safeguard Paladin's Class Bonus (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/CombatLogic.php:4479-4484, inside OnDealDamage's non-combat prevention chain: "if(!$isCombat && ... $targetObj->CardID === 'ifmmvbm26h' ...) $amount = max(0, $amount - 2)") only fires when the champion's class matches (CLERIC or WARRIOR). The starting champion's CardID is patched directly to Jin, Fate Defiant (WARRIOR) to satisfy that condition -- but Jin's own element is NORM, not FIRE, so a FIRE-element damage spell (Focused Flames, tried first) can't be activated once the champion patch drops the default Spirit of Fire lineage's FIRE unlock (confirmed via a throwaway debug harness, now deleted, showing CanActivateCardForSelection failing on CanPlayerUseCardElement while CanActivateCard alone returned true). Nascent Blast (vajycopxgf, cardActivatedAbilities/CardActivated-1, GeneratedMacroCode.php ~22398-22410/37158-37166) is NORM element instead (always usable regardless of champion element) -- a 3-reserve ACTION spell that deals 3 non-combat damage to target unit via DealDamage -> OnDealDamage, activated from hand and targeted at Safeguard Paladin itself. The target MZCHOOSE is queued directly after the 3rd reserve payment with no EffectStack decline step (same as trusty-steed-enter-ally-power-buff's ALLY On Enter target choice, unlike ignite-the-soul-damage) -- confirmed via RunIntegrationTests --verbose after an initial attempt with an extra PASS step got silently consumed as the target choice itself. Final damage is 1 = Nascent Blast's 3 damage minus Safeguard Paladin's Class Bonus 2 prevention.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] If non-combat damage would be dealt to Safeguard Paladin, prevent 2 of that damage. (Apply this effect only if your champion's class matches this card's class.)
